name: Local Traffic AI - IG Auto Poster

nodes.name: Daily 9am ET
nodes.notes: Fires once a day at 09:00. Server timezone should be set to America/New_York in n8n settings, or convert in the cron line.

nodes.name: Pick Today's Post
nodes.notes: Finds the calendar entry whose date == today (ET). Returns empty (stops) if nothing is scheduled today.

nodes.name: Create Media Container
nodes.notes: Step 1 of IG publishing: create a media container. Returns an id (creation_id) used to publish. image_url must be publicly reachable by Facebook's servers.

nodes.name: Wait 30s (container processing)
nodes.notes: IG needs a moment to fetch and process the image into the container before publish. 30s is safe for a single image. Poll the container status endpoint instead if you want to be precise.

nodes.name: Publish to Instagram
nodes.notes: Step 2: publish the container. Counts against the 25-posts / 24h limit per IG account. Returns the published media id.

nodes.name: Log Success
nodes.notes: Shape a clean success record. Wire this into a Google Sheet / Airtable / DB append node to keep a posting log if you want one.

nodes.name: Nothing Scheduled
nodes.notes: Calendar has no entry for today. End cleanly.

meta.description: Pulls the post scheduled for today from calendar.json, finds its rendered asset, and publishes it to an Instagram Business account via the Instagram Graph API (two-step container then publish). Stops cleanly on days with no scheduled post. Env vars required: IG_BUSINESS_ID, IG_ACCESS_TOKEN, ASSET_BASE_URL, and either CALENDAR_JSON or a Read File node feeding $json.calendar.
